name: Wine Bar v0.10.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Widen the gaps between pinned apps by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/27
* Update dependencies by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/28
* Add the ability to switch between DXVK and WineD3D by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/29
* Add year 2026 to copyright headers by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/30
* Improve logging messages in SpecialExecutableBloc by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/31
* Get rid of the ProcessOutput class by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/32
* Don't pass StartupData around - use an async singleton instead by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/33
* Prevent interaction with the prefix list item of a prefix being removed by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/34
* Handle WStringException thrown from toWindowsFilePath() by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/35
* Detect users trying to run an app that won't be accessible under muvm by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/36
* Disable startup notification by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/37
* Add version information to AppImages by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/38
* On the prefix list page, indicate which prefixes have running apps by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/39
* Add version numbers back to AppImage file names by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/40
* Unset the AppImage environment variables at an earlier stage by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/41
* Switch from the `material_design_icons_flutter` to the `flutter_material_design_icons` package by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/43
* Switch from the `file_picker` to the `file_selector` plugin by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/42
* Keep `X-AppImage-*` properties out of winebar.desktop by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/44
* Disable the Back button when the prefix is being created by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/45
* Fix the "being deleted" prefix status jumping to the next prefix in the list by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/46
* Don't pass environment variables to Process.start() in non-muvm case by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/47
* Add file-based logging to production builds by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/48
* Return early if gpu-enumerator exits with a non-zero exit code by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/49
* There is no need for LocalStoragePaths.get() to be async by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/50
* When trying to open a 2nd instance of the app, focus the existing window by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/51
* Add support for building a Snap package of Winebar by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/52
* Remove the uinput interface from snapcraft.yaml by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/53
* Add `lld` and `llvm` to flutter build dependencies by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/54
* Fix a step name in the release workflow by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/55
* Fix logging in to snapcraft during the release process by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/56


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/compare/v0.9.0...v0.10.0

name: Wine Bar v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Mention additional dependencies needed to build WineBar by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/16
* Fix a wrong log message by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/17
* Add back buttons to prefix creation steps by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/18
* Fix loading the app icon by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/20
* Fix Windows apps receiving WineBar's icon on the task bar by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/21
* Make installer-runner and pin-executable-info-extractor to log to separate files by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/22
* Wait not just for the installer to finish, but also for its subprocesses by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/23
* Fix automatic pinning of items put on Desktop by an installer by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/24
* Treat updated files on Desktop as new ones by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/25
* Introduce the ability to select a particular GPU to run a pinned app by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/26


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/compare/v0.8.0...v0.9.0

name: Wine Bar v0.8.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Implement `Use the WOW64 mode if available` toggle by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/1
* Implement upgrading the settings.json file by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/2
* Fix the .DirIcon symlink in AppImage by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/3
* Verify the generated files are up to date in the CI build workflow by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/4
* Update the README.md file by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/5
* Add Ko-fi username to FUNDING.yml by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/7
* Fix the application icon not showing up in some desktop environments by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/6
* Add borders to the "Unpin" and "Kill process" buttons by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/8
* Convert the icon path relative to the executable to the absolute path before loading it by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/9
* Add animations to the lower bar buttons and to the Pin Executable button by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/10
* Add a button to run the winecfg executable by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/11
* Make the bouncing animation of running special executables less pronounced by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/12
* Add demo video to README.md by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/13
* Fix the new value of `Use the WOW64 mode if available` not being taken into account immediately by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/14
* Fix a bug that caused unintentional unsuppressing of previously suppressed warnings by @Tulon in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/15

## New Contributors
* @Tulon made their first contribution in https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/pull/1

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tulon/WineBar/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0
